items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Had a guy, his nickname was Ape Man. He played little things around there.

ctx.x: But I was going to say, when you were growing up as a kid, you were talking about your father playing piano. Did other people in the neighborhood play piano? Were the other piano players? Was that kind of a tradition?
Well they had a few guys around playing, but they played, you know, they all played by ear, different ones. Had a guy, his nickname was Ape Man. He played little things around there. Ape? Ape?
Yeah, Ape Man. Ape Man, yeah.
